styles.base: 2D cartoon animation style illustration, like a modern hand-drawn animated TV series: bold clean dark-brown outlines, flat cel shading with one soft shadow tone, bright warm saturated colors, small glossy highlights, cute and slightly absurd.
styles.isolated: Single subject centered and fully visible, filling about 80% of the frame, nothing cut off. Fully transparent background, no ground shadow, no frame, no border, no panels. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers or watermark.
styles.ingredient: A cute food mascot: {desc}. It has a small simple kawaii face (two shiny dot eyes, tiny {mood} mouth, light blush). No arms, no legs.
styles.tool: A collectible magical kitchen item, drawn like a treasured game relic: {desc}. No face on the object.
styles.dish: A finished Chinese-style dish, appetizing, three-quarter top view, wisps of steam: {desc}. No face, no chopsticks hand, no people.
styles.boss: Bust portrait (head and shoulders, facing slightly left) of a funny cartoon character: {desc}. Expressive animated-series character design.
styles.item: A game item icon: {desc}. No face.
styles.character: A funny cartoon character, full body: {desc}. Expressive animated-series character design.
